contract.name: PhoneInput
contract.summary: Sorleed's international phone-number field with label, country selector, number input and helper or error. The contract records the CSS and native HTML reference implementation plus the private-alpha React adapter; the Figma reference is unresolved and is not asserted.
contract.maturity: contract; framework-agnostic CSS + native HTML; React private-alpha adapter

evidence: The Figma reference is unresolved. No node ID, variant ID or property key is asserted by this contract.
components/phone-input/phone-input.css and phone-input.html are the canonical framework-agnostic implementation.
react/phone-input/index.tsx is a private-alpha adapter and is not represented as production-ready.
The adapter uses libphonenumber-js when available; numbering-plan validation cannot prove a number is active, reachable or owned.
No IP geolocation and no forced default country are implemented or permitted.

component: Render the full field anatomy with label, country selector, number input and helper or error row.
Apply only phone-input component tokens for colour, geometry and typography.
Expose accessible labeling and association between label, country selector, input and messages.
Expose native disabled state and suppress focus treatments when disabled.
Expose the native input value and change events without owning validation.
application: Choose or infer the appropriate default country without relying on IP geolocation.
Supply required-field validation, user-facing error copy and the aria-invalid presentation.
Decide when to require a complete international number and when to validate.
Handle form submission, focus management and announcements.
Explain why a field is disabled rather than relying on the muted fill alone.
figmaOnly: No Figma evidence is recorded for this component. Design-time property mapping is not asserted.

intended: Collecting international phone numbers in global forms where users may travel.
Forms requiring E.164 normalisation when a valid international number is provided.

inappropriate.use: Assuming a single country for all users without explicit configuration.
inappropriate.reason: Sorleed is international and hardcoding a country is not allowed.
inappropriate.alternative: Infer from an existing international number or require explicit selection with no forced default.

inappropriate.use: Treating a calling code alone as a unique country identifier.
inappropriate.alternative: Present full country names in the selector and allow disambiguation.

inappropriate.use: Using IP geolocation to auto-select a country.
inappropriate.reason: Not permitted due to privacy and accuracy concerns.
inappropriate.alternative: Use explicit defaultCountry, infer from an E.164 value or no default.

structure: Row containing the country selector and number input
Country container with class .sl-phone-input__country and a visually hidden label
Country selector with class .sl-phone-input__country-select and an accessible name
Number input with class .sl-phone-input__field and type=tel
Message row with class .sl-phone-input__message; error adds .sl-phone-input__message--error

literals.reason: No max-width token exists. The country selector stays proportional to the row without a fixed pixel width.
No motion token exists in the 229-token source. The transition is cosmetic and does not change state semantics.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Visible label text and accessible name for the number input.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Must be non-empty. When hideLabel is true the label is visually hidden, not removed.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it programmatically associated.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Do not use display:none or aria-hidden on the only label.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Supporting copy shown when there is no error.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Replaced by errorMessage when an error is present.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Error copy shown in the message row and connected through aria-describedby.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Sets aria-invalid=true. The application owns when validation runs.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Controlled editing value, preserved exactly as typed.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The adapter does not reformat or reject intermediate input.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Initial value for the uncontrolled adapter.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Not applied while value is controlled.
No IP geolocation. The country code is not inferred from the calling code alone.
The application provides this explicitly or leaves it undefined.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Called when the country selector changes.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The adapter does not rewrite the current number when the country changes.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Optional allow-list of ISO country codes.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: When omitted, the adapter lists every country reported by libphonenumber-js.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Accepted for API compatibility with an international-number intent.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The current private-alpha adapter accepts this prop but does not change behaviour from it. Do not rely on it.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Called on every input change with inputValue, optional e164, country, status and isValid.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The adapter reports status but does not display an error by itself; the application supplies errorMessage.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Disables both the country selector and the number input.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Native disabled attribute; suppresses hover and focus presentation.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Sets the native required attribute on the number input.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The application owns required validation and visible required indication.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Passes the native readOnly attribute to the number input.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: ReadOnly has no dedicated visual treatment in the stylesheet. Do not present it as a distinct state.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Native form field name for the number input.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The country selector has its own generated id and is not submitted under this name.

codeOnlyProperties.description: Identifier for the number input; the country selector uses the same id plus -country.
Layout-only escape hatch for the wrapper.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: Must not change colour, typography, radius, height, border, gaps or focus treatment.

codeOnlyProperties.type: InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> excluding type, value, onChange and aria-describedby
codeOnlyProperties.description: Standard attributes such as placeholder, maxLength, pattern, aria-* and data-* pass through to the number input.
codeOnlyProperties.notes: The adapter sets type=tel, inputMode=tel and autoComplete=tel.

variants.name: Default
variants.notes: White fill, control boundary, primary text and tertiary placeholder. Focus ring is bound but hidden.

variants.name: Hover
variants.notes: Only the border changes to phone-input.border-hover; the error state suppresses this treatment.

variants.name: Error
variants.notes: The error border is keyed to aria-invalid=true and the message carries phone-input.text-error.

variants.name: Disabled
variants.notes: Muted fill, matching border and muted text. Disabled wins over Error, Hover and Focused.

validCombinations.result: White fill, phone-input.border boundary, primary text and tertiary placeholder.
phone-input.border-hover boundary while the pointer is over an enabled, non-invalid control.
Muted fill, matching disabled border and muted text; no interaction.
Default boundary plus the focus overlay.
Hover boundary plus the focus overlay.
Error boundary and message plus the focus overlay.
Disabled wins; no focus overlay is rendered.
The error border persists; the hover border is not applied.
Disabled wins; no error border or error-coloured message.

precedence: State precedence: Disabled > Error > Hover > Default.
Focus is an orthogonal overlay in Default, Hover and Error; Disabled suppresses it.
Disabled suppresses error and hover treatment.
conflicts: Error + Hover is not modelled. Do not add a hover border on top of the error border.
Disabled + Error is not modelled. Do not show an error border or error message on a disabled field.
Disabled + Focused is not a visible combination. The focus overlay must be suppressed.
Focus is not a fifth State. Do not create State=Focus.
Calling codes are not unique country identifiers; do not model a calling code as a country.
notes: The focus overlay is an independent pseudo-element, not a State variant.
The React adapter reports validation status through onChange; it does not render an error unless the application supplies errorMessage.
Figma state names and booleans are not DOM attributes, props or ARIA values. No Figma evidence is currently recorded.

tokens.rule: Component code consumes only phone-input.* component tokens. Colour tokens alias semantic roles; geometry and typography alias primitives where applicable.
forbidden: Do not consume primitive or semantic tokens directly.
Do not hardcode values when a token exists.
Do not use IP geolocation.
Do not introduce phone-input.success.*, phone-input.warning.* or phone-input.loading.* tokens.

design.requirement: The label must be programmatically associated with the number input.
design.verification: Inspect the for/id association and the computed accessible name.

design.requirement: The country selector must have an accessible name.
design.verification: Inspect the computed accessible name; do not rely on the flag or dial code alone.

design.requirement: Error messages must be associated with the number input.
design.verification: Check aria-describedby or aria-errormessage and aria-invalid.

design.requirement: Keyboard focus must show the focus overlay at 2px width and 2px offset.
design.verification: Tab to each control and inspect the rendered overlay geometry.

production.requirement: The country selector and number input must be keyboard navigable using native controls.
production.verification: Keyboard-only test; confirm native select and input behaviour and no keyboard trap.

production.requirement: Do not rely on flags alone to identify countries.
production.verification: Check that each option exposes a full country name and dial code.

production.requirement: Focus must be visible; disabled removes the controls from interaction.
Error is communicated by a border and a text message, not colour alone.
production.verification: Render an error and inspect the message text and grayscale rendering.

production.requirement: Use the native disabled attribute on both controls and do not present an error while disabled.
production.verification: Assert disabled, absence from interaction and no aria-invalid presentation.

production.requirement: ReadOnly must not be described or styled as a distinct state.
production.verification: Inspect the DOM and stylesheet for readOnly-specific treatment.

contrast.notes: Aliases the same semantic roles as Input placeholder; measured from resolved token values.
Aliases the same semantic roles as Input error text; measured from resolved token values.
Inactive control; WCAG 1.4.3 and 1.4.11 exclude disabled controls.

allowed: Change label, helper, error and placeholder copy; all are application-owned.
Control the field width and responsive behaviour through the surrounding layout.
Provide an explicit defaultCountry or a controlled country value.
Restrict the country list with countries.
Supply errorMessage and the matching aria-invalid presentation from the application.
Override phone-input.* token values at the theme layer while preserving the alias chain and revalidating contrast.
forbidden: Hardcoding colours, radii, heights, padding, gaps, font sizes or weights.
Using IP geolocation to choose a country.
Forcing a default country without explicit application configuration.
Identifying a country by calling code alone or relying on flags alone.
Adding success, warning, info, loading or clearable states.
Presenting an error on a disabled field.
Claiming that a valid number is active, reachable or owned.
Replacing the native select with a non-keyboard-accessible custom listbox without a new contract.
themeOverrides: Consumers may remap semantic roles so phone-input.* colours resolve to a brand palette.
Every override must preserve the component-token alias chain and be revalidated for text, boundary, focus and error contrast.
Do not add new phone-input.* names in a theme; a missing role requires a token-source change and a new contract version.
Light theme is the only implemented theme. Dark mode is not available and must not be simulated by inverting values.

canonical: Render the full field: label above the row, country selector and number input in the row, helper or error below.
Use one label per field and keep it associated with the number input.
Show full country names and dial codes; allow disambiguation where calling codes are shared.
Let the application validate on blur or submit and supply errorMessage.
Pair the field with Button for form submission and a secondary cancel action.
Use helper text for format guidance before an error occurs.
Keep a stable id for each field so label, helper and error references remain valid.
forbidden: IP geolocation or an unconfigured forced default country.
A calling code used as the only country identifier.
Flags as the only country label.
Helper and error messages shown at the same time.
A red border without an error message.
An error presented on a disabled field.
Validation that claims a number is active, reachable or owned.
A fixed pixel width that cannot respond to its container.

invalidConfigurations.configuration: Auto-detecting country from the IP address
invalidConfigurations.why: Not permitted by design; it is private, unreliable and not explicit.
invalidConfigurations.correct: Use explicit defaultCountry, infer from an E.164 value or leave the country unset.

invalidConfigurations.configuration: Identifying a country solely by its calling code
invalidConfigurations.why: Multiple countries share calling codes, so the selection would be ambiguous.
invalidConfigurations.correct: Present full country names and allow disambiguation.

invalidConfigurations.configuration: Claiming active, reachable or owned status from format validation
invalidConfigurations.why: Numbering-plan validation cannot prove deliverability or ownership.
invalidConfigurations.correct: Describe the result as format validity only.

invalidConfigurations.configuration: Defaulting every user to one country without configuration
invalidConfigurations.why: Sorleed is international and a hardcoded country is misleading.
invalidConfigurations.correct: Require explicit configuration, infer from an international value or start unselected.

invalidConfigurations.configuration: A disabled phone field with aria-invalid=true and an error message
invalidConfigurations.why: Disabled wins over Error; a disabled field must not present validation state.
invalidConfigurations.correct: Withhold the error presentation while disabled and explain the unavailability separately.

visual.given: The PhoneInput is rendered on a supported light surface.
visual.when: Default, Hover, Error and Disabled are captured.
visual.then: Fill, border, text, placeholder, label and message resolve to the stateMapping tokens; no hex or px literal covered by a token appears.

visual.given: Default, Hover and Error with keyboard focus.
visual.when: The number input and country selector are inspected.
visual.then: The 2px focus overlay at 2px offset appears; the base border, text and message remain unchanged.

visual.when: The controls are focused programmatically or inspected.
visual.then: No focus overlay appears and both controls use disabled tokens.

visual.given: A PhoneInput at a responsive width.
visual.then: Controls are 40px high with a 6px radius, 1px border, 12px horizontal padding, 8px label gap, 4px helper gap and 8px row gap.
The label is visually hidden but still occupies the accessibility tree; the layout gap collapses.

behaviour.then: The result reports status=empty, isValid=false and no e164 value.

behaviour.given: A partial international value such as +123.
behaviour.then: The editing value is preserved, isValid=false and e164 is undefined.

behaviour.given: A valid international number such as +12125551234.
behaviour.then: The result reports status=valid, isValid=true and the normalised e164 value.
The editing value is preserved, isValid=false and e164 is undefined.

behaviour.given: A controlled country prop and a defaultCountry prop.
behaviour.then: The controlled country wins over the default.
Only the allowed ISO country codes appear.
The adapter does not rewrite or discard the current editing value.
The rendered value follows the parent.
The adapter reports status through onChange but does not render an error or set aria-invalid by itself.
The current private-alpha adapter produces the same behaviour; the prop is accepted but unused.

accessibility.then: The number input has a programmatic label whose text matches the visible label, including when hideLabel is true.
It has an accessible name and each option exposes a country name and dial code.

accessibility.given: A PhoneInput with helperText and no error.
accessibility.then: The helper text is connected through aria-describedby.
aria-invalid is true and the error text is connected through aria-describedby.
Both controls expose the native disabled state and are not interactive.
The number input exposes the native required state; the application provides a visible required indication.

accessibility.given: Keyboard focus on the number input and country selector.
accessibility.then: A visible focus overlay is present and not clipped.

limitations.limitation: The Figma reference for PhoneInput is unresolved and is recorded as null.
limitations.impact: There is no design-source evidence for variant or property mapping.
limitations.mitigation: Use the CSS and native HTML reference as canonical; add a verified Figma reference in a later change.

limitations.limitation: The framework-agnostic contract does not include parsing logic.
limitations.impact: Full formatting and validation require an adapter.
limitations.mitigation: The private-alpha React adapter uses libphonenumber-js when available.

limitations.limitation: Numbering-plan validation cannot prove the number is active, reachable or owned.
limitations.mitigation: Describe results as format validity only and do not make delivery claims.

limitations.limitation: The React adapter accepts an international prop but does not currently change behaviour from it.
limitations.impact: Consumers may assume the prop toggles formatting or validation.
limitations.mitigation: Do not rely on it; treat the current behaviour as the documented baseline.

limitations.limitation: The React adapter uses libphonenumber-js country codes as option names rather than full localised country names.
limitations.impact: The selector shows two-letter codes and dial codes, not full country names.
limitations.mitigation: The application may provide its own country label data; the native HTML reference demonstrates full names.

limitations.limitation: The canonical implementation uses a native select; there is no searchable country picker.
limitations.impact: Very long country lists require scrolling and type-ahead from the native control.
limitations.mitigation: Use the native select until a searchable picker has its own contract and accessibility evidence.

limitations.limitation: readOnly is passed to the native input but has no dedicated visual treatment.
limitations.impact: A read-only field is visually indistinguishable from an editable field.
limitations.mitigation: Do not present readOnly as a supported visual state; use disabled only when the field is genuinely unavailable.

limitations.limitation: The adapter reports status but does not own validation timing, error copy or announcements.
limitations.impact: Consumers must supply errorMessage, aria-invalid and focus management.
limitations.mitigation: Follow the accessibility requirements and the native reference markup.

limitations.impact: No dark values exist for any phone-input token.
limitations.mitigation: Ship light theme only. Do not invert values to simulate dark mode.

readOrder: Read components/phone-input/README.md for the human explanation and native API.
Read components/phone-input/phone-input.css and phone-input.html for the canonical implementation.
Read react/phone-input/index.tsx and react/types/index.ts for the private-alpha adapter API.
Read tokens/tokens.json or tokens/dist/tokens.css for canonical token names and resolved values.
rules: Never hardcode a country or use IP geolocation.
Treat calling codes as non-unique and show country names.
Distinguish editing text, normalised E.164 values and validation status.
Do not claim validity means active, reachable or owned.
Use only phone-input.* tokens; never consume primitives or semantic tokens directly.
Keep the full field anatomy: label, country selector, number input and helper/error row.
Let the application own validation, error copy and announcements.
Do not present readOnly or international as fully implemented behaviours.
Do not invent a Figma node ID; the reference is unresolved.
uncertaintyPolicy: If a Figma reference is required, stop and report that it is unresolved; do not invent a node ID.
If the requested surface is inverse or dark, stop and report that it is unsupported.
If the requested treatment is success, warning, info or loading, stop and report that the state does not exist.
If a country is requested as a silent default, ask for explicit configuration.
If a searchable country picker is requested, report that only the native select is implemented.
If deliverability or ownership is requested, report that format validation cannot prove it.
definitionOfDone: The full field renders with label, country selector, number input and helper/error row from phone-input.* tokens.
Default, Hover, Error, Disabled and their focus overlays render correctly; Disabled suppresses the overlay.
The country selector exposes full names and dial codes and allows disambiguation.
Label association, country accessible name, helper/error description, aria-invalid and disabled semantics are present.
No IP geolocation, forced default country or deliverability claim exists.
All 31 token dependencies resolve and match the generated CSS variables.
The native reference markup and the private-alpha React adapter remain consistent with this contract.
The Figma reference remains null until a verified reference is available.

valid.title: International field with explicit helper
valid.code:
<PhoneInput
  id="recipient-phone"
  label="Phone number"
  helperText="Include your country code."
  onChange={({ e164, isValid }) => setPhone({ e164, isValid })}
/>
valid.explanation: No forced country. The application receives editing text, optional E.164 and validity status and decides what to display.

valid.title: Explicit default country
valid.explanation: The default is explicit application configuration, not IP geolocation. errorMessage is application-owned and sets aria-invalid.

valid.title: Restricted country list
valid.explanation: The allow-list limits options; the shared +1 calling code remains visible so the user can disambiguate.

valid.title: Disabled field with an explanation
valid.code:
<PhoneInput
  id="account-phone"
  label="Account phone"
  value={accountPhone}
  helperText="Managed by your account administrator."
  disabled
/>
valid.explanation: Disabled wins over hover, focus and error. The reason is explained in helper copy.

valid.title: Visually hidden but accessible label
valid.explanation: hideLabel hides the visual row but keeps the label programmatically associated.

invalid.title: IP geolocation
invalid.explanation: Country selection must be explicit or inferred from the number, never from the IP address.

invalid.title: Hardcoded default country
invalid.explanation: Hardcoding one country for every user is not international and is forbidden.

invalid.title: Calling code as country identity
invalid.explanation: countries takes ISO country codes, not calling codes; +1 is shared by several countries.

invalid.title: Error on a disabled field
invalid.explanation: Disabled wins over Error. A disabled field must not present validation state.

invalid.title: Deliverability claim
invalid.explanation: Format validity does not prove the number is active, reachable or owned.

invalid.title: Invented Figma node
invalid.explanation: The Figma reference is unresolved. Never invent a node ID or retain a placeholder.
